@cryptoworld202 The majority of cryptocurrencies are neither hot nor cold. They're all attempting to make it through the bear market.

Although some currencies, such as $Luxy and $Doge, are holding up well, these coins will most likely come out of the bear market well and have a strong pump.

@cryptogems555 It scared a lot of people. You should not be terrified in a bear market, honestly. In instances like this, I've learned to always remain calm.

Surprisingly, several coins and tokens have held up well in recent weeks, such as $Doge and $Luxy, which are fine and green.
